name: Ho Chih-chang
bio: Ho Chih-chang, born in AD 659, was a T’ang official and poet, and an early admirer and friend of Li Po. His poem here is a homecoming after long absence.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: The Return
poems.author: Ho Chih-chang
poems.text:
Bowed down with age I seek my native place,
Unchanged my speech, my hair is silvered now;
My very children do not know my face,
But smiling ask, "O stranger, whence art thou?"
